name: audit-labs
description: Audit every lab of the kit in parallel, then merge the findings into one prioritized report.

branches.prompt: Audit app-space/ (the 2D space lab): its config against .kiro/specs/visual-lab/requirements.md, its laws, its measures, and the property that covers it. Report blocking items with the REQ number they break. Do not modify any file.

Audit app-eco/ (the 2D ecosystem lab): its config against .kiro/specs/visual-lab/requirements.md, its laws, its measures, and the property that covers it. Report blocking items with the REQ number they break. Do not modify any file.
Audit app-chimie/ (the 3D chemistry lab): its config, its custom UI, its laws and the property that covers it. Report blocking items with the REQ number they break. Do not modify any file.
Audit app-ponts/ (the 3D bridge lab): its config, its custom UI, its laws and the property that covers it. Report blocking items with the REQ number they break. Do not modify any file.

steps.prompt:
Merge the four lab audits below into one prioritized report: blocking items first (each with its REQ number), then warnings, then nits. Drop the duplicates and say how many labs share each problem.

{{previous.output}}
Write the merged report to .kiro/workflow-output/lab-audit.md. Then state the verdict: shippable or not shippable, and the exact remaining work.
